## Pancake Compressor preview — read before installing

**Preview build.** These installers have been generated by CI but must not be assumed signed or notarised. Technical preview distribution may trigger Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper warnings. Do not disable system-wide security protections to install this app. Wait for signed releases if you are not comfortable testing unsigned developer builds.

Supported download targets (confirm actual assets):
- Windows 11 x64: `.exe` NSIS installer (unsigned unless verified otherwise)
- macOS 13+ Apple Silicon: `.dmg` (unsigned/not notarised unless verified otherwise)
- macOS 13+ Intel: `.dmg` (unsigned/not notarised unless verified otherwise)

**Verification:** Compare each asset's SHA-256 hash against `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Use `gh attestation verify ./<downloaded-asset> --repo OWNER/pancake-compressor` with the actual repository owner to examine build provenance.

**Before promoting to stable:** maintainer must edit notes with actual manual Win/Mac install/uninstall test evidence, exact signature/notarisation status, supported OS list, known codec limitations, security scan results and release-specific changes. See `docs/13-build-install-release.md`.

Free, GPL-3.0-or-later, 100% local processing. No account or file upload required.
